_metadata.description: The complete publication list of https://waymo.com/safety/research/ (55 papers, fetched 2026-08-23). This is the operator-designated priority corpus for ground-truth construction and benchmarking: every entry is a Waymo safety-research publication, and the GT-WMR evaluation set draws its answerable items from these papers first. Titles are verbatim from the page; arxiv_id is filled only where the page itself linked an arXiv PDF/abstract.
